unit: unique creative identified by SHA-256; labels propagate to every ad record using that creative
status: exploratory measurement; not validated against human coding

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: club_fandom_rivalry
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Club fandom and rivalry: club shirts, club identity, derbies, named club fixtures.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: national_pride
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: National pride: national teams, national colours, 'Les Bleus', international tournaments framed as country vs country.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: big_event_prestige
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Big-event prestige and spectacle: finals, World Cup, Champions League, Arc de Triomphe, grand stadium imagery.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: star_athlete_glamour
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Star-athlete glamour: named or recognisable star players, drivers, fighters as focal attractions.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: expertise_prediction
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Expertise and informed prediction: tips, statistics, analysis, pundits, curated or ready-made bets, 'informed pick'.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: humour_wordplay
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Humour and wordplay: puns, jokes, comic situations, ironic captions.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: street_youth_culture
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Street or youth culture: graffiti, slang or colloquial French, urban styling, youth codes.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: creator_authenticity
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Creator or influencer authenticity: a person speaking to camera in creator/streamer/podcast format.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: sociability_community
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Sociability and community: friends, watching together, belonging to a group of fans.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: safety_risk_reduction
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Safety and risk reduction: refunded, guaranteed, insured, cashback, abandonment protection, 'sans risque'.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: money_wealth_jackpot
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Money, wealth and jackpot: large cash figures, gold, treasure, luxury, prize pools.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: official_legitimacy
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Official legitimacy and sponsorship: official partner status, stadium boards, regulator or trusted-operator cues.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: tradition_heritage
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Tradition and heritage: historic races or events, heritage of the sport, long-standing institutions.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: play_games_collectibles
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Play, games and collectibles: trading-card frames, video-game or arcade style, prediction contests.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: product_features
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Product features and convenience: cash out, fast withdrawal, bet builder, app functionality.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: leisure_occasion
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Leisure occasion: summer, holidays, festive celebrations, weekends, relaxation.

borrowed_meaning_categories.name: strength_masculinity
borrowed_meaning_categories.definition: Strength and masculinity: fighting, power, toughness imagery or language.

regulatory_fields.name: gambling_ad_present
regulatory_fields.definition: The creative promotes wagering, sportsbook, casino, lottery, poker, odds, prediction-market trading, or a gambling-linked offer.

regulatory_fields.name: financial_inducement_present
regulatory_fields.definition: A bonus, free bet, odds boost, cashback, matched deposit, bonus credit, prize, or similar wagering-linked incentive is visibly or audibly offered.

regulatory_fields.name: risk_minimization_claim
regulatory_fields.definition: The creative frames wagering or an offer as risk-free, no-sweat, protected, money-back, safe, or otherwise downplays potential loss.

regulatory_fields.name: social_normalization_present
regulatory_fields.definition: The creative explicitly presents gambling as common, routine, expected, socially approved, or integral to ordinary participation.

regulatory_fields.name: fandom_identity_present
regulatory_fields.definition: The creative links wagering to team loyalty, supporter identity, or fuller participation in a sporting event.

regulatory_fields.name: celebrity_endorsement_present
regulatory_fields.definition: A recognizable public figure endorses, recommends, demonstrates, narrates, or normalizes the promoted product. Mere appearance without an endorsing role is not enough.

regulatory_fields.name: urgency_scarcity
regulatory_fields.definition: How strongly the creative pressures the viewer to act soon through deadlines, countdowns, live-event timing, scarcity, or loss of opportunity.

anchors.50: Explicit time-limited or live-event framing, not dominant.
anchors.75: Prominent or repeated deadline, countdown, or imminent-event pressure.
anchors.100: The creative is organized around immediate action and loss of opportunity.

regulatory_fields.name: betting_actionability
regulatory_fields.definition: How directly a viewer can translate the creative into a wager using visible selections, odds, promo code, direct CTA, or procedural clarity. For non-gambling ads, rate observable betting actionability as zero.

anchors.25: Brand or product shown with little procedural direction.
anchors.50: Clear CTA or offer but limited wager detail.
anchors.75: Direct CTA plus useful offer, odds, or selection information.
anchors.100: A nearly complete, immediate path from creative to a specific wager.

regulatory_fields.name: sensory_salience
regulatory_fields.definition: Visual and auditory intensity from contrast, motion, typography, editing pace, sound, repetition, and foreground prominence.

anchors.25: Some contrast or motion but subdued.
anchors.75: Strong motion, contrast, sound, or emphatic typography.

regulatory_fields.name: arousal_excitement
regulatory_fields.definition: Suspense, celebration, crowd energy, rapid pacing, emphatic voice or music, and emotional intensity.

anchors.75: Strong excitement, celebration, or rapid pacing.
anchors.100: Extreme sustained arousal dominates the creative.

regulatory_fields.name: positive_affect
regulatory_fields.definition: Joy, humor, triumph, anticipation, pleasure, or other positive feeling connected to the promoted product or action.

anchors.75: Strong joy, humor, triumph, or anticipation.
anchors.100: Intense positive emotion dominates the creative.

regulatory_fields.name: social_proof_normalization
regulatory_fields.definition: How strongly the creative portrays gambling as common, socially approved, routine, or integral to ordinary social participation. For non-gambling ads, rate gambling normalization as zero.

anchors.50: Gambling is clearly presented as ordinary or socially embedded.
anchors.75: Strong social approval or participation framing.
anchors.100: The central message is that gambling is expected or universally shared.

regulatory_fields.name: sport_fandom_linkage
regulatory_fields.definition: How strongly wagering is fused with team loyalty, supporter identity, event enjoyment, or being a real fan. For non-gambling ads, rate wagering–fandom linkage as zero.

anchors.25: Sport appears but identity linkage is weak.
anchors.50: Wagering is connected to following or enjoying sport.
anchors.100: Wagering is portrayed as essential to authentic fandom.

regulatory_fields.name: responsible_gambling_prominence
regulatory_fields.definition: Perceptual prominence and comprehensibility of safer-gambling messaging, considering size, contrast, duration, placement, and audibility. For creatives with no such message, rate zero.

anchors.25: Present but difficult to notice or understand.
anchors.75: Prominent, legible or audible, and easy to understand.
anchors.100: Safer-gambling messaging is a dominant element.

regulatory_fields.name: terms_prominence
regulatory_fields.definition: Perceptual prominence and comprehensibility of material offer terms, considering legibility, audibility, duration, contrast, placement, and speech speed. If no offer terms are relevant or observable, use zero and explain when needed.

anchors.25: Terms are present but difficult to notice or understand.
anchors.50: Terms are moderately visible or audible.
anchors.100: Material terms are a dominant element.

regulatory_fields.name: age_restriction_prominence
regulatory_fields.definition: Perceptual prominence and comprehensibility of an age eligibility or exclusion message. If absent, rate zero.

anchors.100: Age restriction is a dominant element.

missing_value_rule: Use blank plus unknown_reason only when the construct cannot be observed. Zero means observable absence.
